question: P can complete (1)/(5) of a work in 12 days and Q can complete ​(1)/(6) of a work in 8 days. In how many days can both P and Q together complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

P can complete 1/5 of the work in 12 days.

Q can complete 1/6 of the work in 8 days.

**Formula used:**

Work done per day by P = (Work Fraction / Days)

Work done per day by Q = (Work Fraction / Days)

Combined work per day = Work done by P + Work done by Q

Total days to complete the work = (1 / Combined work per day)

**Calculations:**

Work done per day by P:

⇒ 1/5 work in 12 days

⇒ Work done per day by P = (1/5) * (1/12) = 1/60

Work done per day by Q:

⇒ 1/6 work in 8 days

⇒ Work done per day by Q = (1/6) * (1/8) = 1/48

Combined work per day by P and Q:

⇒ 1/60 + 1/48

Find LCM of 60 and 48 to add the fractions:

⇒ LCM of 60 and 48 = 240

⇒ 1/60 = 4/240, 1/48 = 5/240

⇒ Combined work per day = (4/240) + (5/240) = 9/240 = 3/80

Total days to complete the work:

⇒ 1/(3/80) = 80/3 = 26​​(2)/(3) [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] days

**∴ P and Q together can complete the work in **26​​(2)/(3) [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] ** days.**
